app_store.name: Golden Moments
app_store.subtitle: Zochita za Alzheimer’s
app_store.promotional_text: Zochita zosavuta zosangalalira pamodzi: makadi akulu, zithunzi za banja lanu, popanda koloko kapena zigoli. Chikumbutso chosankha. Palibe akaunti.
app_store.description:
Pezani chochita chosavuta chosangalalira pamodzi. Golden Moments imapereka kufananitsa zithunzi kofatsa ndi kuyang’ana zithunzi pamodzi kwa mabanja ndi osamalira, kuphatikizapo omwe amathera nthawi ndi munthu wokhala ndi dementia kapena matenda a Alzheimer’s. Golden Moments ikupezeka mu Chichewa.

YAMBIRANI PANG’ONO
Yambani ndi makadi anayi akulu ndi zithunzi zodziwika zoyambira. Siyani zithunzi zikuoneka, kapena zibiseni ngati zikukhala bwino. Njira yofatsa ilibe koloko, zigoli kapena chilango. Sankhani makadi 4, 6, 8, kapena 12 monga zilipo.

ZIKHALE ZANU
Sankhani zithunzi za banja pogwiritsa ntchito chosankhira zithunzi cha chipangizo chanu. Golden Moments imasunga makope ang’onoang’ono a zochita za pa chipangizo; siifufuza laibulale yanu kapena kusintha zithunzi zanu zoyambirira. Sungani zithunzi mpaka 24 mu gulu limodzi.

YANG’ANANI PAMODZI
Onani chithunzi chimodzi pa nthawi. Mafunso osakakamiza amalimbikitsa kukambirana popanda kupempha aliyense kukumbukira mayina kapena kupereka yankho lolondola. Kungoyang’ana kokha kukwanira.

POPANDA INTANETI PAMENE KUFUNIKA
Zithunzi zoyambira zimapezeka nthawi yomweyo. Makope a zithunzi zotengedwa amagwira ntchito popanda intaneti atatengedwa. Kusankha zithunzi zoyambirira zosungidwa mu iCloud zokha kungafunike intaneti. Magulu onse asanu ndi atatu a zithunzi ali mu pulogalamuyi, popanda kutsitsa zithunzi zosiyana.

PALIBE AKAUNTI KAPENA SEVA YOGAWANA ZITHUNZI
Makope a zithunzi za banja amakhala mu pulogalamuyi pa chipangizochi. Mungachotse makopewo popanda kuchotsa zithunzi zoyambirira. Zosunga za chipangizo zingakhale ndi zambiri za pulogalamu. Mtundu uwu sugawana zithunzi pakati pa achibale.

Golden Moments ndi ya zosangalatsa ndi kukambirana pamodzi. Siizindikira, siichiritsa, siiteteza kapena kuyeza dementia kapena matenda a Alzheimer’s. Zochitazi sizoyenera aliyense; tsatirani zomwe munthuyo amakonda ndi chitonthozo chake, ndipo imani kapena sinthani chochitacho pakafunika.
app_store.release_notes: Zowonekera zomveka bwino. Masewera oyamba a zithunzi amasiyanitsa awiri aliwonse. Masamba monga Konzani tsiku langa amakwanira bwino ndi mawu akulu, ndipo mawu amatsata kukula kwa foni yanu mpaka kuwirikiza kawiri. Yang’anani pamodzi sikuwerengera zithunzi. Mu Lero, manambala a thandizo ndi a ku U.S., ndipo kwina mugwiritse ntchito nambala ya kwanuko. Matembenuzidwe amapangidwa ndi makina ndipo sanawunikidwe. Ngati chilichonse sichikumveka bwino, tiuzeni kuchokera mu Thandizo ndi chinsinsi.
